prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app composition study, 16:9 landscape
Primary request: Design a complete desktop solving screen for a murder deduction puzzle called ALIBI, direction fixed as a cinematic evidence reconstruction table. This must be an actual application interface with clear regions and controls, not a poster, photograph, moodboard, game cover, or decorative scene.
Structure: compact top case navigation and timer; a horizontal continuity strip showing case steps and 0/4 progress; a dominant square illustrated 4x4 house board using about 60% of the left side; a stacked evidence/suspect working area on the right; a single bottom transport-like command bar; accusation remains permanently reachable at bottom right.
Real content: case MIDNIGHT DELIVERY; four people, Tomas marked VICTIM, Alexander clue On the lamp, Greta clue The only person on the shower, Carol clue The only person on the bathtub; progress 0/4; Place, Mark, Undo, Redo, Clear, Hint x3, Accuse. The illustrated board includes clearly labeled Study, Bathroom, Living Room and recognizable shower, bathtub, bookshelf, lamp, sofa, desk, and box.
Visual world: 1940s film editing continuity desk translated into modern forensic interaction. Matte near-black magnetic steel, smoky olive and graphite panels, bone-white evidence strips, projector amber as the active color, oxblood only for danger. Contact-sheet portraits, grease-pencil annotations, magnetic number markers, perforated film-edge rhythm, subtle diagonal projector beam.
Typography: condensed industrial headline, narrow technical labels, monospaced evidence copy. Sharp corners and clipped tabs; no generic rounded cards, pills, glassmorphism, neon cyberpunk, cream parchment dashboard, or skeuomorphic clutter.
Composition option B — Continuity Desk: the progress strip behaves like a film timeline and makes the solve sequence obvious; suspect records expand in place in the right working area; the selected clue aligns horizontally to a precise board coordinate; command bar resembles restrained editing transport controls while remaining familiar.
Show the full solving workflow and enough lower content to prove the complete screen. Use semantic UI text only. No invented claims, testimonials, pricing, brand logos, watermark, or fictional commercial copy.
selectionRationale: Best product clarity: the continuity strip externalizes the placement sequence, the board remains dominant, suspect evidence is scannable, and the action hierarchy maps cleanly to desktop and mobile.
